name: 网页搜索 / 浏览器
description: 通过本地浏览器驱动搜索网页并读取正文。真实浏览器,默认无头;需要先装好 D:\project_ai\web_search。

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web with a real (headless) browser and return structured results. Use it whenever the answer depends on current facts (versions, dates, prices, news) — do not answer from memory. Returns JSON with title/link/snippet per result: judge relevance from the snippet, then open the page with web_read. A 'warning' field means anti-bot degradation — retry with another engine.

query.description: What to search for. Keep it short — it is typed into a search box.

engine.description: Search engine: bing (default, most reliable), baidu, google, duckduckgo, zhihu.

max.description: How many results to return (default 8, max 20).

args: import json,sys,subprocess; p=json.load(sys.stdin); a=['python', r'D:\project_ai\web_search\ws.py','search',p['query'],'--engine',p.get('engine') or 'bing','--json','--max',str(int(p.get('max') or 8))]; r=subprocess.run(a,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=120); sys.stdout.write(r.stdout if r.returncode==0 else (r.stdout or '')+(r.stderr or '')); sys.exit(r.returncode)

tools.name: web_read
tools.description: Read the main article text of one web page as markdown (navigation and ads stripped; long pages truncated to max_chars). Ground conclusions in text read here rather than in search snippets. Use it after web_search to open a promising result.

max_chars.description: Truncate the extracted text to this many characters (default 8000).

args: import json,sys,subprocess; p=json.load(sys.stdin); a=['python', r'D:\project_ai\web_search\ws.py','read',p['url'],'--format','text','--max-chars',str(int(p.get('max_chars') or 8000))]; r=subprocess.run(a,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=120); sys.stdout.write(r.stdout if r.returncode==0 else (r.stdout or '')+(r.stderr or '')); sys.exit(r.returncode)
